# Chapter 10: Common AI Tools and Platforms

## Navigating the AI Tool Landscape

The AI tool landscape is vast, confusing, and constantly changing. New tools emerge weekly, existing tools add AI features monthly, and the lines between categories blur constantly. This chapter provides a practical guide to understanding the AI tool ecosystem, evaluating options, and selecting the right tools for your business.
